description: Credit this API key after a USDC transfer on Base mainnet. Pass the transaction hash. Verifies the on-chain Transfer to the configured payment address, required confirmations, and amount, then credits the ledger once (tx hash + log index is unique). A transaction claimed by one customer cannot be claimed by another. Call get_payment_info first for the address and packs. x402 is a future option and is not implemented.

tx_hash.description: Base mainnet transaction hash of the USDC Transfer (0x-prefixed).

name: claim_payment
